headline: Zuari International Limited files Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial share acquisition in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals
sum: Zuari International Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited. The filing marks a formal regulatory milestone in an acquisition process that may involve a full or partial stake purchase.
detail: Zuari International Limited has submitted a disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, confirming a material shareholding event in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited. The specific acquisition percentage, consideration, and timeline of the share purchases are not yet detailed in publicly available summaries. This filing initiates the mandatory disclosure and post-acquisition compliance regime under the Takeover Code.
